title: H358 stub: Agentic autonomous factor investing — self-directed signal engine
rationale: arXiv:2603.14288 'Beyond Prompting: Autonomous Framework for Systematic Factor Investing via Agentic AI' (Mar 2026) presents a self-directed AI engine that endogenously formulates trading signals without sequential manual prompts. Key differentiator from our existing H349 (QuantaAlpha) and H352 (TreEvo): a memory-update mechanism that steers subsequent hypothesis generation toward signals that work in *changing* market conditions, enabling adaptation to regime shifts that fixed factor sets cannot handle. The paper's 'agentic factors' adapt better than static factors across multiple market regimes in backtests on US equities. Architecture: (1) signal formulator agent generates alpha expressions, (2) evaluator agent scores on IC/Sharpe, (3) memory agent logs what worked and updates generation priors. This is the closest paper to a production-viable autonomous hypothesis testing loop — directly relevant to automating our dream cycle research pipeline. H352 (TreEvo) is a single-shot 200-evaluation miner; H358 is a continuous adaptive loop. Implementation note: uses OpenAI API ($OPENAI_API_KEY available in env); authors suggest Claude-class models as alternatives.
